results.title: Guru Nanak seals quarter-final berth
results.description: Shree Guru Nanak Khalsa College has secured its place in the quarter-finals of the Extra Fiji Secondary Schools Football Championship 2026 after finishing the Under-19 pool stage unbeaten in Labasa. Guru Nanak capped its Pool A campaign with a convincing 3–1 victory over MGM High School today, finishing top of the pool with seven points. [...]

results.title: 2026 Football Previews: Lambert striving to continue strong run under Marc Beach
